text: {"memo": "As of the most recently completed fiscal year, Oracle (ORCL) reported results for fiscal year 2024, which ended May 31, 2024. Revenue was $53.2 billion, up about 9% from $48.9 billion in fiscal 2023. Net income was $21.0 billion versus $12.5 billion in fiscal 2023, and diluted EPS was $5.56 versus $3.42 in fiscal 2023. The business showed stronger profitability, with operating margin expanding from prior years. In fiscal 2023, revenue was $48.9 billion, net income was $12.5 billion, and EPS was $3.42. In fiscal 2022, revenue was $40.4 billion, net income was $7.8 billion, and EPS was $2.24. Cash flow remained robust, with operating cash flow around $21.7 billion in fiscal 2024. Cloud infrastructure and database growth continued to drive top-line momentum, though currency headwinds weighed results. The company’s revenue growth has gradually decelerated from the double-digit cloud-driven pace of fiscal 2020-2021, but profitability and cash generation stayed strong. Fiscal 2024 is the most recent complete year as of March 31, 2025. The stock’s view: ORCL remains a premium growth-and-cash story, but valuation and deceleration risks persist."}
